TC18.notes:
1. Where descriptions come from currently:
Same source as cover images — BookData/Nielsen via Ebility. When a book is mapped to the web list, Ebility pulls the publisher blurb from BookData and writes it into the BLURB field in PUBLISHER.DBF. That's what gets synced to WooCommerce as the product description.

2. Where stored locally:
PUBLISHER.FPT on the shop machine alongside PUBLISHER.DBF in Z:\bookscan\SABSSAVE\. The .FPT file is the memo file that actually holds the BLURB text — the .DBF just has a pointer to it. Louisa's zip only contained the .DBF files, not the .FPT files, which is why descriptions are empty in our local tests.

When the sync runs on the shop machine, dbfread will automatically find PUBLISHER.FPT in the same directory and the BLURB field will populate correctly.

So TC18 is a conditional pass — empty locally by design, will work in production. Worth confirming during the Chrome Remote Desktop session that PUBLISHER.FPT exists in Z:\bookscan\SABSSAVE\.
